contract: A durable bounded production run pins the canonical series revision, author/universe references, chapter work revisions, immutable draft artifacts and editorial run evidence. Each call advances at most one stage. Configured-model output is staged as an immutable candidate and cannot change a WorkStore draft before explicit approval. Pause, restart, retry exhaustion, cancellation, residual editorial findings, keep/review and rollback remain explicit durable states.
acceptance: Start is idempotent and optimistic; unprepared chapters or changed series revisions pause with exact residuals instead of generating or claiming progress.

Model mode uses only the configured reasoning adapter with bounded typed output and bounded attempts; failure pauses or exhausts without fabricated content. Authored mode is explicit and never represented as model generation.

Candidates are immutable artifacts separate from canonical work drafts. Apply approval promotes the exact pinned bytes; editorial evidence pins its draft/artifact/context revisions; keep/review or rollback is explicit and unrelated text/history remains intact.
Pause and cancel requests are durable and observed between stages and after provider work. Reopening a store demotes a running marker to a resumable runtime-restarted pause.
Real HTTP, native-tool and console journeys exercise the same store and expose source pins, residuals, approvals and terminal state without provider/model/home/runtime overrides.
limits: A configured external reasoning model may be unavailable during isolated qualification; successful generation remains external evidence, while adapter failure must remain truthful and non-mutating.
This child implements bounded production orchestration only. EPUB/PDF export is creative.14, and scheduled unattended production is not claimed.
creative.19 is the true implemented editorial prerequisite. Parent creative.12 remains externally unqualified for successful configured-model literary quality and complete multi-issue acceptance.
